name: Stripe
description: Stripe's hosted server reads and creates customers, products, prices, invoices and payment links and searches Stripe's documentation. Try it in a test-mode account first.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (access.stripe.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
